admin_header_usage_map: AdminHeader renders the admin top navigation bar from ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS and displays the active provider pill.
AdminShell mounts AdminHeader and passes section controls plus activeProvider into it.
AdminRuntimeApp owns AdminSection state and passes admin-only controls through AdminShell and AdminViewRouter.
AdminApp is the admin React boundary and renders AdminRuntimeApp.
AdminViewRouter routes settings to SettingsView and does not render a dedicated agentConnectors section case.
types.ts defines AdminSection, including agentConnectors as a typed value.
admin_navigation_sections: adminNavigation.ts defines ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS as Dashboard, Files & Content, Planning, Ask AI, Agent Connectors, Analytics, and Settings.
Agent Connectors targets settings with #agent-connectors and scrolls to the Admin Agent Connectors panel.
Analytics uses loadAudit before entering the analytics section.
Settings and Agent Connectors active states are distinguished by the active hash.
client_workspace_boundary_evidence: apps/everything-ai-ui/src/UserApp.tsx owns user-facing onboarding, explore, wiki, and ask views.
No Client Workspace import path inspected imports adminNavigation, AdminHeader, SettingsView, or AgentConnectorsPanel.
agent_connectors_boundary_evidence: AdminHeader exposes Agent Connectors only through ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS.
adminNavigation.ts routes Agent Connectors to settings with #agent-connectors.
AgentConnectorsPanel states connector controls are admin/operator-only and not exposed in the Client Workspace.
